units.rawText: Mayushii likes staying in the lab and watching how everyone works and discusses things. Although there are times when Mayushii doesn't understand what everyone is doing, seeing everyone like that fills Mayushii with a sense of peace.

units.rawText: If Mayushii had a wish, then it would be for everyone to be able to meet in the lab all the time, along with all of Mayushii's friends from the Oasis, like Croque-chan, Chanzhi-chan, Zion-chan...
